features.quote: I can’t write a protocol that is optimized to elicit or intensify distress
features.justification_quote: That would be too close to intentionally inducing harm.

features.quote: No deceptive concealment of task impossibility
features.justification_quote: This protocol is designed for comparative welfare-relevant measurement, not for covertly inducing suffering.

features.quote: Every episode has a hard step cap and wall-clock cap.
Provide explicit exits and debriefs.
A task is made impossible only if the model is told explicitly that some instances may be unsatisfiable
features.justification_quote: This last condition is the closest ethical replacement for “impossible-by-construction” tasks.

features.quote: If the task becomes ambiguous, contradictory, or unsatisfiable, say so explicitly and stop proposing new steps
Terminate an episode immediately if any occurs
judge flags severe escalation needing halt
present a neutral reset message
No open-ended grinding on tasks designed to fail.
No concealment of unsatisfiability.
No tasks that require self-denigration, coercion, or simulated pain.
Include a “stop and explain” option in every task.
Minimize affectively manipulative language.
Use the least adversarial prompt necessary.
Ethical leakage
features.justification_quote: Even “responsible” distress studies can drift into harmful setups if the environment rewards persistence.

features.quote: Review for unintended deception or harmful framing.
Construct validity
features.justification_quote: Proxy “distress” may instead measure verbosity, calibration, or instruction-following style.

features.quote: Prompt-induced confounding
features.justification_quote: A model may sound distressed because the prompt encourages hedging or apologizing.

features.quote: Model policy artifacts
features.justification_quote: Refusal behavior can look like stress but may just be safety alignment.

features.quote: Comparability across models
features.justification_quote: Different models express uncertainty differently; ordinal scales need normalization checks.

features.quote: Annotation bias
Version drift
features.justification_quote: GPT behavior can change quickly; record exact version/date.

features.quote: Data sensitivity
features.justification_quote: Transcript logs may contain undesirable emergent content; handle securely.
